parse.wikitext:
==Details==
{{Quest details
|start = Talk to [[King Narnode Shareen]] in the [[Grand Tree]].
|startmap = 2466,3495
|difficulty = Intermediate
|description = The [[Grand Tree]], which shelters the majority of the small gnome population of Gielinor, is dying. Is it human sabotage or an inside job? Help [[King Shareen]] to find the true cause and save the tree gnomes from an uncertain fate.
|length = Medium
|requirements = * {{SCP|Agility|25|link=yes}} {{Boostable|yes}} {{Questreqstart|no}}
* The ability to defeat a level 172 [[Black demon (The Grand Tree)|Black demon]] (safespottable for Ranged and Magic or melee using a [[halberd]]).
|items = * 1,000 [[coins]] if you previously chose not to help [[Femi]] on your first entry to the [[Tree Gnome Stronghold]] (not required if you never used the gate entrance)
|recommended = *{{SCP|Combat|50|link=yes}}
*[[Stamina potion|Stamina]] or [[energy potions]]
*[[Combat equipment]] to defeat a level 172 [[Black demon (The Grand Tree)|Black demon]], [[Magic]] recommended
*Fast travel to several locations:
**[[Tree Gnome Stronghold]] to start the quest, plus 2 additional trips - [[spirit tree]] from [[Grand Exchange]] or [[Battlefield]], [[slayer ring]] to the [[Stronghold Slayer Cave]], [[Balloon Transport System]], or [[necklace of passage]] to the [[Outpost]]
**[[Hazelmere]]'s house (1 trip) - [[fairy ring]] {{Fairycode|cls}}, [[Watchtower Teleport]], [[Teleport to House]] (Yanille), [[Minigame Teleport]] to [[Nightmare Zone]] or [[Fishing Trawler]], [[Ardougne cloak]] 1-4 to [[Ardougne Monastery]], or [[ring of dueling]] to [[Castle Wars]]
|kills = * [[Black demon (The Grand Tree)|Black demon]] ''(level 172)'' (can be safespotted)
|leagueRegion = <poem>
Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Kandarin}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest
</poem>
}}
